task: multi-task binary classification: P(EC50 < 1000 pM) per receptor (GCGR, GLP1R, GIPR); 1000 pM = 1 nM
architecture: mean of 5 fold models; each is a shared MLP trunk (max_len*7 -> 256 -> 128 -> 64, ReLU, BatchNorm, dropout 0.2) with one linear head per receptor, trained with masked focal loss (alpha 0.25, gamma 2)
input: per-token features from FeatureExtractor.get_token_features: Kyte-Doolittle hydrophobicity, pH 7.4 side-chain charge, residue MW (the first three z-scored with each fold's own statistics), D flag, lipid flag, sin/cos of position; zero-padded to max_len 44 tokens and flattened
weights_layout: fold1.pt ... fold5.pt, each with state_dict, in_dim, receptors, max_len and scaler; cv_metrics.csv

training_data.sources: ChEMBL GLP-1R EC50 (cAMP direct, EXACT) and all_sequences_aligned.csv; replicate EC50s merged by geometric mean; a missing EC50 is a masked label
training_data.receptor_column_assumption: EC50_T1 = GCGR, EC50_T2 = GLP1R, EC50_T3 = GIPR (assumed order, not confirmed by the source file)
training_data.cv: 5-fold, folds grouped by CD-HIT clusters at 80% identity, 20% of the training part held out for early stopping

cv_metrics: weights/cv_metrics.csv (per fold and receptor: AUC-ROC, AUC-PR, F1, precision, recall, balanced accuracy)
